item_short_desc: Rothco’s Ragg Wool Watch Cap is the perfect addition to your outerwear collection, providing unparalleled warmth and comfort during cold weather. Crafted from high-quality ragg wool, this watch cap offers exceptional insulation, ensuring your head stays warm even in the chilliest conditions. The double-layer construction adds an extra level of warmth and protection, making it an essential accessory for winter. Designed to fit most head sizes, our Ragg Wool Watch Cap is made in the USA, guaranteeing top-notch quality and durability.
